registryBasis: The official Zhumadian municipal government service portal lists the Zhumadian Real Estate Registration Service Center as the implementing body for real-property query and related registration services. Its real-property query guide requires an authorized query subject, property within the office jurisdiction, complete application material and a clear lawful purpose. No anonymous public parcel-map or geometry-only route was found.
